defect_units.missing: share of feature cells set missing
defect_units.duplicates: duplicate rows added, share of rows
defect_units.leakage: share of rows where a leaked proxy equals the label

meta.metric: balanced accuracy on a clean held-out test set (30% of each dataset, untouched)
meta.loss_definition: 100 * sum(BA_clean - BA_defect) / sum(BA_clean - 0.5) over the pooled runs (paired by dataset, model and seed): share of above-chance balanced accuracy lost, headroom-weighted
